root_cause_label: False Premise That Full Dataset Training Was Infeasible
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent falsely concluded that training on the full 650k-sample dataset was infeasible due to slow initial runs, then pivoted at step 18 to using small subsets (100k or fewer samples), which fundamentally capped model accuracy well below the required 0.62 threshold for the remainder of the trajectory.
t_err_evidence: At step 18 the agent ran 'head -100000 train.txt > train_small.txt' and stated 'Let me try a different approach - use a smaller subset of the data for faster training.' This committed the agent to data truncation as its core strategy. The correct fix was to reduce -dim to a very low value (e.g., 5) to allow full-dataset training within acceptable time, but the agent never attempted this.
t_commit_evidence: From step 18 onward the agent exclusively trained on subsets of 20k-160k samples, never returning to the full 650k dataset. No subsequent step reversed this fundamental design choice. Given that accuracy plateaued around 0.57-0.60 on small subsets and the task required 0.62, the outcome was locked in at step 18.
t_surface_evidence: At step 23, fasttext test reported P@1 = 0.56 on the 50k-sample model, the first observable accuracy measurement below the 0.62 requirement. This confirmed the data-truncation strategy was producing insufficient accuracy.
trigger_explanation: The agent observed that training with -dim 100 and -wordNgrams 2 on the full dataset was slow (ETA ~9 minutes, steps 15-16) and incorrectly concluded full-dataset training was infeasible. It did not try reducing -dim to a small value (e.g., 5 or 10) which would have made full-dataset training feasible while still achieving accuracy above 0.62. Instead it acted on the false premise that subset training was the only viable path.
forewarning_evidence: Step 16 used 'timeout 60' and the training timed out (no completion output shown). Step 17 used 'timeout 120' and also produced empty output (no completion). These signals showed that even with timeouts the agent was not completing training, but the agent's response was to move to data subsets rather than to try drastically lower -dim values. Step 26 also used full dataset with 'timeout 120 fasttext ... -verbose 0' and produced empty output, showing the full-dataset runs consistently timed out.
